Chapter One: Six A.M., November First, Nineteen Ninety-Three. As the autumn sun finally broke through the boarded windows of Pumpkin Pete's Pizzeria, the heavy iron blast doors hissed open, and the demolition crews arrived at the front gates.

Chapter Two: Behind the false wall in the Marionette Alcove, inspectors discovered a padlocked steel workshop door stamped with the initials of founder Silas Vane—sealed from the inside since Halloween Eve, Nineteen Eighty-Seven.

Chapter Three: On the workbench lay Vane's final leather-bound ledger and four brass music-box cylinders. His notes revealed that the four autumn mascots were engineered to patrol the building forever, guarding the workshop from intruders.

Chapter Four: With your final paycheck in hand, you stepped out into the crisp November morning as the bulldozers rolled in. Yet deep beneath the rubble, the faint chime of an antique Carillon could still be heard.

Uh, hello? Hello, hello? Welcome to your night shift at Pumpkin Pete's Autumn Jamboree! Listen closely, because the wiring in this old place drains battery fast. The three vintage Halloween mascots tend to wander after midnight. Pumpkin Pete takes the east side through the Arcade toward your right door. Watching him on camera slows him down, but once he reaches the East Corridor, check your right hallway light and shut the right door if he's standing there! Barnaby Stitch, the scarecrow, creeps down the West Hall to your left door. Cameras don't slow him down at all, so check your left light often! And whatever you do, don't forget Camera Three—keep Madame Hexa's carillon music box wound up, or she'll sprint straight for your left door! Stay sharp, watch your power meter, and see you at six A.M.

Uh, hello? Hey, you made it to Night Two! Great job! Listen, a quick heads-up: Grimshaw the Plague Crow back in Camera Five, the Arcade Alley, has started waking up. Keep an eye on his curtain in Cam Five—if he steps out and bolts down the East Hallway, slam your Right Door immediately! Also, we wired an Audio Decoy to your camera tablet and a switch on your desk fan, just watch the office temperature if you shut the fan off!

Hey, Night Three already! You're tougher than the last guard. Look, things are getting serious tonight. All four mascots are active now, and when they get close to a camera lens, their servos emit electromagnetic surges that can jam your video feed. Hit the Reboot Camera button on your monitor if a feed goes haywire. Don't forget Madame Hexa's music box on Cam Three!

Hello? Hello?! Listen to me, if you're hearing this on Night Four, don't let your battery drop! They're coordinating now—Stitch jammed my left door while Grimshaw sprinted down the East Hall, and the Carillon is running out! Wait—someone's outside the window—the door button isn't responding—no, stay back!

Welcome to Halloween Night, little watchman. No more recordings to help you now. The harvest is ready, the Carillon is unwinding, and all four of us are coming for the office. Let's see if your battery lasts until six A.M.

Wait—how is this line still active?! If you're working the Halloween Overtime shift, listen to me: the boiler room seal in Camera Seven broke! Silas Vane's original clockwork prototype is crawling through the overhead air ducts in Camera Eight! Watch the ceiling vent and use your Vent Shutter!
